target: Build a network-free, fixture-backed interactive repository planner foundation on PCP Core with deterministic conflicts and merge-order recommendations.
invariants: Risk lane is L2 because portfolio schemas and authority-boundary projections are introduced.
This packet is inactive until TP-DMX-REPOSITORY-MERGE-PLANNER-DESIGN-001 is accepted on main.
PCP Core generic export behavior remains unchanged for arbitrary Git repositories.
All planner outputs declare authority NONE, surface class PROJECTION, and is_proof false.
No network, credentials, source-repository writes, Task Orchestrator writes, merge, acceptance, or activation.
Byte-identical input produces byte-identical canonical portfolio output.

execution.stacked_because: First executable vertical slice; freezes contracts consumed by all later packets.

commit.message: feat(pcp): add fixture-backed repository planner foundation

pr.title: feat(pcp): add repository planner foundation
pr.body: Fixture-backed, network-free PCP planner foundation with strict schemas, deterministic conflicts and recommendations, provenance, and an interactive read-only UI. L2; one final independent audit required after head freeze.

steps.task: Freeze source-backed, redacted foundation fixtures and integrity metadata.
requirements: Create SOURCES.json entries with repository, exact ref, path or URL, fetched_at, SHA-256, privacy class, and redaction reason.
Represent current Dopemux evidence plus bounded illustrative AdOps and dNh cases; do not treat the existing sha256:PLACEHOLDER dNh fixture as live evidence.
Include one blocking conflict, one stale fact, one unknown, one dependency, and one local-only candidate blocked as REMOTE_COMMIT_ABSENT.
Write failing integrity tests before fixture transformation code.
validation: Every fixture byte is listed and hashed.
Fixture scan contains no token, credential, raw transcript, or user-local absolute path.
Tests fail before the fixture loader exists and pass after implementation.

steps.task: Define strict source and portfolio schemas plus immutable Python models.
requirements: Implement SourceRef, Claim, SourceSnapshot, Conflict, LaneProjection, PortfolioProjection, and Recommendation as frozen dataclasses or equivalent immutable models.
Define ProjectExtensionAdapter with matches(generic_export: Mapping[str, object]) -> bool and enrich(generic_export: Mapping[str, object], source_root: Path) -> SourceSnapshot.
Expose load_extension_adapters(manifest_paths: Sequence[Path]) -> tuple[ProjectExtensionAdapter, ...] using manifest adapter_mappings; unknown modules and duplicate extension IDs fail closed.
Expose load_source_snapshot(payload: Mapping[str, object]) -> SourceSnapshot.
Reject unknown top-level fields and require authority NONE, surface_class PROJECTION, and is_proof false.
Keep lifecycle facts distinct from readiness recommendations.
validation: Schema and model tests cover valid, unknown-field, missing-provenance, authority-promotion, and malformed-hash cases.
No model mutates its input mapping or sequence.

steps.task: Implement deterministic conflict classification and merge-order recommendations.
requirements: Expose classify_conflicts(claims: Sequence[Claim]) -> tuple[Conflict, ...].
Expose build_portfolio(sources: Sequence[SourceSnapshot]) -> PortfolioProjection.
Expose plan_merge_order(portfolio: PortfolioProjection) -> tuple[Recommendation, ...].
Expose canonical_portfolio_bytes(portfolio: PortfolioProjection) -> bytes using UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, and one trailing LF.
Open blocking conflict, stale proof, missing audit, failed gate, missing dependency, and cycle must withhold readiness.
Stable topological tie-breaker is project_id, lane_id, candidate_sha.
validation: Randomized input ordering produces byte-identical output ordering.
Simulation never changes any SourceSnapshot or fixture byte.
Overrides route to Control Tower review and never auto-merge.

steps.task: Render the first interactive planner screen from the generated foundation snapshot.
requirements: Create RepositoryPlannerPage, PortfolioTable, LaneDetails, ConflictPanel, and ProvenancePanel.
Show all three repositories with ready-for-review, blocked, stale, unknown, and conflicting states.
Every material claim links to source locator, observed head, hash, and freshness.
Provide keyboard navigation, semantic status text, focus return, loading/error states, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do not add a service, network call, refresh action, or approval control.
validation: UI tests assert status text rather than color alone.
No component exposes merge, acceptance, activation, or source-write controls.
The DCP nine-family facade is byte-unchanged.

steps.task: Freeze the content head, run deterministic gates, and obtain one independent L2 audit.
requirements: Generate proof from real commands and exact Git state.
Audit PCP genericity, non-authority, determinism, provenance, accessibility, and forbidden-path absence at the exact frozen head.
Any audit mismatch, SKIPPED, FAIL, or NEEDS_SUPERVISOR blocks readiness.
validation: Proof and audit bind the exact final content head.
PR remains unmerged pending Control Tower disposition.
